operations.description: Proposes order intents that move an account towards target weights.

inputs.name: broker
inputs.description: Provider id of the broker every intent must name.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Account id every intent must name.

inputs.name: positions
inputs.description: JSON array of BrokerPosition: what the account holds.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: JSON array of TradingTarget: the weights to move towards.
